nodes.label: Ownership table: production deployment/rollback, security incident response, availability, lead-delivery/Resend reputation, privacy requests, Search Console health all currently Unassigned/Required

Service map: Next.js app/route handlers, Vercel deployment, Redis REST rate-limit/anti-replay state, Google PageSpeed Insights (audit dependency), Resend (lead email), optional consent-gated GA4/Clarity/Vercel Analytics/Meta/Cal.com/Tawk.to

Rate limiter trusts only Vercel's x-vercel-forwarded-for header when VERCEL=1; a non-Vercel production deployment buckets clients into one conservative 'unknown' bucket until an explicit adapter is reviewed

First response: confirm incident time/route/deployment, preserve logs without pasting secrets, check deployment diff/status pages, promote last known-good or revert without rewriting shared history, rotate credentials on suspected compromise

Failure mode: public audit returns 503 - check Redis REST URL/token/mode/HMAC secret and reachability; production intentionally fails closed; never switch to the in-memory limiter as an outage workaround

Failure mode: public audit returns 400/502 - 400 can be an intentional private-address/URL-policy rejection; check PageSpeed status/quota and bounded-fetch timeouts for 502s; never weaken private-address/redirect/size controls to pass one target
Failure mode: leads do not arrive - check route response and Resend event/delivery status, RESEND_FROM_EMAIL/AUDIT_NOTIFY_EMAIL/domain auth, rate-limit/idempotency logs, bounce/complaint rates
Failure mode: analytics or chat missing - first confirm visitor granted the relevant consent category; missing optional analytics must never block forms or core navigation
Failure mode: unexpected third-party requests - reproduce with a fresh profile before/after each consent choice, disable the responsible integration, preserve request URL/initiator/consent state

Recovery and retention decisions required: approved RTO/RPO values, verified provider backup/export behavior across source control, DNS, Redis, Resend, analytics, Search Console, and CRM; Redis keys are disposable, not a lead backup
Post-incident review: record scope, user impact, data affected, root cause, detection gap, recovery actions, notification-duty assessment, preventive tasks with owners/dates

hyperedges.label: Production reliability pattern: service map, incident first-response, release rollback, and performance release gating together form the operational reliability loop

Consent-gated vendor loading pattern: the same GA4/Clarity/Meta/Cal.com/Tawk.to/Vercel-Analytics vendor set and consent-first rule recur across the claims register, runbook service map, form-analytics privacy boundary, and the analytics-missing failure mode
